# Plate assets: sources and licences

Everything in `assets/world/` is either CC0 or generated by this project's own scripts.

## Generated by this project
| File | How |
|---|---|
| `props.glb` | `blender/world/build_props.py` (Blender 4.5): imports the CC0 Poly Haven models below, decimates them, recentres origins, exports glTF with 512 px textures (JPEG colour/ORM, PNG normals) |
| `tex/*_diff.jpg`, `*_arm.jpg`, `*_nor.png` | `blender/world/build_textures.py`: resized copies of the CC0 Poly Haven scans below |
| `tex/signs.jpg` + `signs.json` | `build_textures.py`: storefront, neon, lightbox, street-name and WALK signs rendered with Pillow |
| `tex/props_atlas.jpg` + `props_atlas.json` | `build_textures.py`: sawhorse board, cone, mailbox, newspaper boxes, phone booth header, hot-dog cart, food labels, Con Ed stack stripes |
| `tex/ripples_nor.png`, `tex/steam.png`, `tex/ad_staypuft.png` | `build_textures.py`: procedural puddle ripples, steam puff, faded painted wall ad |
| All other geometry (street, kerbs, facades, windows, fire escapes, lamps, signals, trees, crates, sawhorses, cones, benches, booth, mailbox, cart, food, litter) and all wetness, paint and window masks | procedural, `src/world/*.js` at load time |

## Fonts used only to render sign textures (font files are not shipped)
Google Fonts: Oswald, Alfa Slab One, Monoton, Bebas Neue, Pacifico, Archivo Black (SIL Open Font License 1.1); Yellowtail (Apache License 2.0).

## Names
All shop names, newspaper mastheads and the hotel name are invented ("McGrath's", "Ray's Pizza", "Hotel Ardsley", "The Gazette", "Evening Star", "Daily Herald"). "Stay Puft Marshmallows" is a nod to the Ghostbusters universe. Street signs read N Moore St / Varick St (the real corner of the film's firehouse).
